description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing books in a book-tracking application. It provides endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting books. It includes dependency injection for services and model mapping with custom converters for enums and predefined shelves. The controller handles request validation and error responses.

classes.name: BookController
classes.description: A REST controller class providing API endpoints for book management, including listing, retrieval, creation, modification, and deletion of books. It uses service classes for business logic and ModelMapper for converting DTOs.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of books, optionally paginated. Throws bad request for negative page number.

methods.name: getGenres
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all available book genres.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single book by its ID, throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: addBook
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new book from a DTO, returns the created book, or throws validation errors.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to partially update an existing book identified by ID.

methods.name: convertToBook
methods.description: Converts a BookDto into a Book entity using ModelMapper.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a book by ID, returns 404 if not found.
